title: Tech Note: Backup and Recovery Strategies for Mission-Critical 4D Server Databases - Part 2

historical_commentary.text: This note documents best practices for keeping mission-critical 4D Server installations (described here as handling up to 100 users and 5GB data files, considered large for 1997) running 24/7 using 4D Backup's automatic backup and mirroring features; the general discipline of backup/recovery planning remains conceptually sound, but the specific 4D Backup product and its capacities described here are dramatically outdated relative to today's data volumes and 4D's modern backup mechanisms.
related_updates: 4D Backup's automatic backup and mirroring features have been substantially enhanced and integrated into later 4D Server versions with modern journaling and log-file-based recovery

1997-era 'mission-critical' data volumes (100 users, 5GB) are trivial by today's standards, so the scale-related advice is outdated even though the backup/recovery discipline it teaches remains valid in principle
